title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Lewis University
description: Ten under-21-safe food runs in Romeoville and nearby communities, each backed by a current official location page showing service at 11 p.m. or later on at least one night.

cards.title: McDonald's on Independence
cards.subtitle: Romeoville drive-thru and lobby run
cards.notes: Check the day before leaving campus: Friday and Saturday service extends to 2 a.m., while the posted closing time is 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.
cards.short_summary: A Romeoville option with weekend hours reaching 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official McDonald's location page identifies the restaurant at 645 N Independence Boulevard and posts lobby and drive-thru service until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Romeoville, IL at 645 N Independence Blvd | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Restaurant, lobby, and drive-thru hours are posted as 4:30 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday, 4 a.m.–2 a.m. Saturday, and closing at 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; verify holiday hours.

cards.title: Wendy's on Weber Road
cards.subtitle: Every-night Romeoville drive-thru stop
cards.notes: Use this for a close-to-town late run: posted service reaches 1 a.m. most nights and 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday, with drive-thru hours matching.
cards.short_summary: A seven-night option whose posted hours extend past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official location page lists 58 S Weber Road in Romeoville and shows restaurant and drive-thru hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 58 S Weber Rd. in Romeoville, IL
cards.access_notes: Posted restaurant and drive-thru closing is 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Rosati's Romeoville
cards.subtitle: Weekend pizza carryout or delivery
cards.notes: Plan this run for Friday or Saturday, when the official store page posts an 11 p.m. close; carryout and delivery are the listed location features.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza branch with an extra late hour on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Rosati's official Romeoville page lists the 463 N Weber Road location, carryout and delivery, and Friday–Saturday hours ending at 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Friday–Saturday; the page lists carryout and delivery.

cards.title: La Colonia on South Weber
cards.subtitle: Friday-and-Saturday sit-down dinner
cards.notes: Choose Friday or Saturday for the posted 11 p.m. close, and call ahead if arriving near closing because the official page does not separate kitchen hours.
cards.short_summary: A Romeoville Mexican restaurant posting later weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: La Colonia's official website lists its restaurant at 634 S Weber Road in Romeoville and posts Friday and Saturday hours from 10 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: La Colonia Mexican Bar & Grill | Romeoville
cards.access_notes: The restaurant posts 10 a.m.–11 p.m. Friday and Saturday, 10 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday–Thursday, and 11 a.m.–8 p.m. Sunday; confirm kitchen service near closing.

cards.title: White Castle in Bolingbrook
cards.subtitle: A nearby run with service to 1 a.m.
cards.notes: Head north to the named Bolingbrook location when a post-midnight window matters; its official page currently posts a 1 a.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A nearby slider stop whose official hours run into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: White Castle's official location page identifies the restaurant at 120 S Bolingbrook Drive and posts castle hours from 7 a.m. to 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently posts daily castle hours of 7 a.m.–1 a.m.; recheck the page before making the drive.

cards.title: Bolingbrook IHOP
cards.subtitle: A round-the-clock diner run
cards.notes: Use this when timing is uncertain: the official page marks every weekday as open 24 hours and lists dine-in, takeout, and online ordering.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Bolingbrook dining room with all-day meal choices.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official page for 730 Janes Avenue in Bolingbrook lists the restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday and identifies late-night food as an amenity.
cards.source_title: IHOP Breakfast in Bolingbrook, IL on 730 Janes Ave
cards.access_notes: The official location page posts 24-hour service every day, with dine-in, takeout, delivery, curbside pickup, and online ordering listed.

cards.title: Denny's on North Frontage Road
cards.subtitle: Round-the-clock Bolingbrook breakfast
cards.notes: Take this route when the group wants a seated meal after midnight; the location page lists walk-ins, groups, takeout, and continuous service.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Bolingbrook diner designed for any-time breakfast or dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page lists 126 E North Frontage Road in Bolingbrook as open 24 hours daily, with round-the-clock breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
cards.source_title: Denny's | 126 East North Frontage Rd. | Order Online
cards.access_notes: The official page posts 24-hour service every day and lists walk-ins, group seating, takeout, breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

cards.title: Denny's on Plainfield Road
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour Joliet alternative
cards.notes: Use this southwest option for a no-closing-time diner run; the official page confirms walk-ins, takeout, group seating, and round-the-clock breakfast.
cards.short_summary: A continuously open Joliet diner for a longer late-night run.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official page identifies the 2531 Plainfield Road restaurant in Joliet and posts 24-hour service seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: The location is officially posted as open 24 hours every day, with walk-ins, group seating, takeout, breakfast, lunch, and dinner listed.

cards.title: Wendy's on Route 59
cards.subtitle: A Plainfield drive-thru open to 2 a.m.
cards.notes: Choose this farther Plainfield branch only when its uniform 2 a.m. close suits the plan; official hours cover dine-in, carryout, delivery, and drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A Plainfield branch posting the same late closing time all week.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official page for 13407 S Route 59 in Plainfield posts restaurant and drive-thru service from 10 a.m. to 2 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 13407 S. Rt. 59 in Plainfield, IL
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant and drive-thru hours are 10 a.m.–2 a.m. daily; the page notes that holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy's on Plainfield Road
cards.subtitle: A Joliet run with a 3 a.m. close
cards.notes: Save this longer drive for the latest window on the board: the official location page posts a consistent 3 a.m. close throughout the week.
cards.short_summary: A Joliet quick-service option officially listed through 3 a.m. nightly.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official page lists the restaurant at 2900 Plainfield Road in Joliet and posts hours from 10 a.m. to 3 a.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 2900 Plainfield Road in Joliet, IL
cards.access_notes: The official page posts restaurant hours of 10 a.m.–3 a.m. every day; check the live page before departure for operational changes.

warnings: Late hours can change without notice; users should recheck each linked official location page before departure.
La Colonia serves alcohol but publicly presents itself as a family-welcoming restaurant rather than a 21+-only venue; this card refers only to restaurant dining.
Several options are in neighboring Bolingbrook, Plainfield, or Joliet and require a longer drive from Lewis University.
